description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the length of a gold prefix and a BLEU score. The x-axis is labeled “the length of gold prefix” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” and has a linear scale ranging from 23 to 29, with tick labels at intervals of 1. A blue dashed line with circle markers, labeled “Inconsistency: wait-9”, begins at approximately (0, 24.5) and increases to approximately (20, 28.5), with a local minimum at (1, 24.5) and a local maximum at (17, 28). A red dashed line with square markers, labeled “Inconsistency: wait-9”, begins at approximately (0, 25.5) and decreases to approximately (20, 25), with a local maximum at (2, 26.5) and a local minimum at (18, 24.5).
